limitations: TFF is a category aggregate for a contract market and report date, not a panel of named independent dealers.
Dealer membership, classifications and economic contract scope can change over time.
May 2023 consolidated equity-index reports include associated e-micro contracts; this can change economic coverage and comparability.

Contract market code is a useful literal identifier, but the reviewed documentation gives no guarantee that economic meaning is immutable across history. Preserve leading zeros and non-numeric characters.
2010 annual link label begins July 20; full 2010 coverage has not been verified. Historical archive coverage and backcasting must be documented after authorized access.
Monday holiday position dates exist; consecutive weekly records cannot be defined as weekday Tuesday plus date difference exactly seven days.
Position date, release date, and first-vintage availability are different; annual archives do not prove complete historical point-in-time availability.
Official FAQ says no complete historical release-date list, only approximately thirteen months of release dates.

Official FAQ says historical data is not updated after publication, while special notices separately describe corrections/reclassifications; preserve download bytes and notice evidence rather than assuming a complete vintage history.
Futures Only contract counts are not dollar risk, total balance-sheet inventory, or counterparty-level bilateral exposures.

CFTC reportability threshold of twenty traders does not imply twenty qualifying markets. If fewer than twenty contracts pass the frozen research filters, report all qualifying contracts and the shortfall without relaxing filters.
Actual archives, headers, report-type marker values, dates, duplicate keys and completeness remain unverified until E2 is independently committed and data access is authorized.
calendar_design_considerations_not_froze: Freeze a global expected report-week calendar for the selected interval, separately from individual contract observations.
Map official as-of dates to report-week slots with documented holiday exceptions; do not silently collapse missing weeks.
Separate government shutdown or ION publication delays from genuinely missing position-week records.

If modeling availability, separately specify and audit release-date overrides and unresolved historical availability; do not label position-date analysis as a fully verified point-in-time release backtest.

rights.status: Government information public domain; acknowledge CFTC; third-party resources can have separate rights.

nyfed_comparison_boundary: This task consulted no non-CFTC sources. The CFTC measure is a futures-contract category aggregate, not a matched NYFed dealer sample. NYFed units/universe must be supported separately by its owning source.
